name: Gallium, germanium, antimony
note: Bolivia produces antimony; grouped because the Chinese export controls of 2023-2024 covered them together.
uses: Gallium: semiconductors and LEDs; germanium: fibre optics and infrared optics; antimony: flame retardants, lead-acid batteries and ammunition.
why_it_matters: China's export controls of 2023–2024 covered the three together; Bolivia produces antimony, which is why the group is tracked here.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures

hs_codes.description: Unwrought gallium, germanium, indium, niobium, rhenium, vanadium; waste and scrap
